description: This PHP source file defines the class LeadsVarDefHandler, which extends VarDefHandler, to customize the behavior of vardef array generation for Leads in SuiteCRM. It overrides the get_vardef_array method to filter out legacy call and meeting fields when a specific meta_array_name is used.

classes.name: LeadsVarDefHandler
classes.description: A class extending VarDefHandler to specialize vardef array generation for Leads, filtering certain legacy fields.

methods.name: get_vardef_array
methods.description: Overrides the parent method to filter out 'oldcalls' and 'oldmeetings' from the vardef array when the 'rel_filter' meta_array_name is used.
